updates.title: CVE-2026-97785: AAD App Proxy Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A critical authentication bypass in Azure AD App Proxy allows unauthenticated attackers to escalate privileges over the network. Admins should apply the available security update immediately to protect hybrid identity infrastructure and on-premises application access.

updates.title: CVE-2026-80092: Microsoft Identity Web Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An elevation of privilege vulnerability in Microsoft Identity Web (versions 3 and 4) has been patched in versions 3.16.0 and 4.16.1 respectively. Organizations using Identity Web for authentication should update to these versions to secure their authentication pipeline.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Decouple Policy Tips and Email Notifications
updates.summary: Admins can now independently configure policy tips and email notifications in Data Loss Prevention rules for SharePoint and OneDrive, instead of requiring both to be enabled together. This gives compliance teams finer control over user notifications and audit trails for DLP policy violations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: IRM Alert Classification
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now supports manual classification of alerts as True Positive, Benign (operational), or False Positive with predefined reasons, replacing the previous dismissal workflow. This capability helps compliance teams better track and report on actual risk signals versus noise, improving tuning and governance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection Auto-Labeling Coverage Report
updates.summary: Compliance admins can now view per-policy coverage reports that compare which files were labeled during enforcement against the latest simulation snapshot. This transparency helps identify labeling progress and detect files processing outside the simulated dataset, enabling better policy tuning.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Protection Integration with Data Lifecycle Management
updates.summary: Adaptive Protection now integrates with Data Lifecycle Management to automatically apply retention labels based on a user's dynamic insider risk level. This allows admins to preserve deleted emails and files for high-risk users while deleting them for low-risk users, balancing governance with operational efficiency.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Microsoft Graph will provide unified access to archive mailboxes (main and auxiliary) for Data Lifecycle Management, replacing deprecated EWS APIs. This modernization simplifies compliance workflows and ensures long-term API compatibility as Exchange Online moves away from legacy protocols.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Azure PST Import for Data Lifecycle Management
updates.summary: A new PST import method allows admins to migrate PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage directly into Exchange Online mailboxes using the standard Exchange Migration Service workflow. This capability streamlines data ingestion for compliance and archive scenarios without requiring on-premises infrastructure.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Hard Delete Capability for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management will support hard delete through secure priority cleanup workflows, allowing compliance admins to permanently remove content after the standard 93-day recycle bin retention period. This feature addresses regulatory requirements for irreversible data destruction while including safeguards against misconfigured policy incidents.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Now Monitors FTP and SFTP Transfers
updates.summary: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention can now detect and restrict sensitive data transfers over FTP and SFTP protocols, closing a gap in data protection for file transfer scenarios. Organizations can configure FTP/SFTP transfer activities within Endpoint DLP policies to enforce restrictive actions based on compliance requirements.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Network Data Security: Entra Global Secure Access Integration
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access now integrates with Purview to enforce DLP policies and monitor user risk activity at the network layer across browsers, apps, APIs, and AI platforms. This prevents sensitive data from reaching untrusted cloud applications while detecting insider risk signals in real time.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Barriers Policy Compliance Report
updates.summary: A new compliance report for Information Barriers policies identifies SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint Embedded containers that no longer comply after policy changes. This helps admins quickly detect and remediate non-compliant resources when information barriers are updated or tightened.
